description:
Thanks Art W For sponsoring this event!  They create beautiful works of art, and they would like to help you paint the army or miniature of your dreams. https://www.artwstudio.com/

===============GAME INFO=============

Aiden and Jordan have a friendly rivalry going back years.  It's time to see that rivalry on the big screen with another 40k live stream!

Both generals bring armies they are intimately familiar with.    Aiden the Thousand sons: Lots of magic, lots of ranged shenanigans.  Jordan brings Tyranids:  Move blocking meta plays, sneaky charges, and sometimes nigh un-killable centrepieces. 


===============ARMY LIST=============
SHADOW OF THE HARRIDAN

FACTION: Tyranids
FORCE DISPOSITION: Disruption
DETACHMENT: Subterranean Assault

CHARACTERS
- Tyranid Prime with Lash Whip
- Neurotyrant
- Hive Tyrant — Enhancement: Tremor Senses
- The Red Terror

BATTLELINE
- Hormagaunts

OTHER DATASHEETS
- Zoanthropes
- Biovores
- Harridan
- Raveners
- Tyrannofex
- Von Ryan’s Leapers
- Von
